title: Chapter 250 Touch My Daughter?
content:
Chapter 250 Touch My Daughter?

When Gu Chen heard Lu Xue’s question, he didn’t know how to answer.

He didn't know that kind of existence.

In fact, he had just left the customs a few days ago and was preparing to contribute to the deserted city of the fairy world.

The same is true for the other An Xing and others.

Faced with this sudden terrifying existence, they were also confused.

"Miss, it's okay. With the city lord here, there won't be any trouble."

At this time, Awei spoke.

As soon as these words were said, they immediately felt as if a tranquilizer were used to relieve everyone present.

Lord, this is their confidence.

As long as Lu Daosheng is still there in Huangcheng, there will definitely be no accident.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded slightly.

"I'm scared to death. The master will definitely teach the other party a lesson!"

Ao Qing looked angry, but also felt a little scared.

Although the other party's strength is so terrifying, he can't do anything at all.

But the little master had something wrong with him, and even if Lu Daosheng didn't blame him, he would not forgive him.

Everyone stopped talking, but looked up at the void.

The whole deserted city suddenly became quiet for a moment.

However, it was only a moment.

The next moment.

Buzz —

A long river surged out from the city lord's mansion, soared upwards, and flowed straight into the void.

Everyone in the city suddenly shook all over, and then widened their eyes and looked at the city lord's mansion.

At this moment, the whole world seemed to be still.

I saw a hazy figure appearing at the source of the long river, stepping on the long river, walking step by step towards the void.

The sound is very crisp.

Every time he takes a step, the terrifying and mysterious aura on his body will grow stronger.

At the same time, the whole world was trembling.

Feeling the terrifying figure, everyone's hearts were like storm.

What kind of existence does this exist?

It seems to be walking in the past, but also as if it is in the future. The great way of heaven surrounds the body and step on the long river of time.

Looking at the past and present, all the powerful monsters have become overshadowed in front of him.

This is the real strong man in the world!

Finally, the footsteps stopped, and the figure was already standing in the void.

The haze gradually turned into clarity, and Lu Daosheng's face also appeared in the eyes of the world.

"Who gave you the courage to touch my Lu Daosheng's daughter?!"

Lu Daosheng looked above the sky and roared in a low voice.

Accompanied by its unique aura, the sound surged in all directions like waves, and finally entered the sky.

Everyone looked at the majestic figure and their faces moved.

It's the Lord of the Wilderness City!

At this moment, Lu Daosheng was really angry.

If you don’t pay attention, your baby daughter almost got into an accident.

In the city, Lu Xue looked at Lu Daosheng's figure, her eyes were moist and she choked up.

"father,,"

Buzz —

At this moment, a strange aura suddenly appeared in the sky.

"Who are you?"

A hoarse voice sounded, as if I had never spoken for so many years.

When Lu Daosheng heard that the other party was still asking about his identity, he immediately clenched his fists and his veins bulged.

In an instant, a terrifying murderous intent surged out of Lu Daosheng's body, and the entire void was dyed blood red.

"Who am I? I am the one who killed you!"

"The Heaven-Catching Hand!"

Lu Daosheng took action.

Suddenly, a supreme giant hand formed by a condensation of starlight appeared from the void and then suddenly headed towards the sky.

The momentum was so great that it seemed to be about to crush the entire sky.

This is the first time Lu Daosheng has used a move since he activated the system.

And it is an unprecedented killer move!

It can be seen how angry Lu Daosheng was at this moment.

boom!

I saw that the giant hand directly pierced the sky through a ferocious hole, and countless fragments of void poured down from the sky, and the meteor fell.

Immediately afterwards, a shrill scream came from the sky.

"Impossible, how could there be such a strong man as you in this world?!"

At this moment, Lu Daosheng's body had turned into a black hole, as if he could swallow everything.

Obviously, it is because Lu Daosheng's strength is too strong that this world can no longer bear him.

But this world is helpless.

The heavenly way of the Wood Immortal Realm was even more trembling.

At this time, Lu Daosheng was still staring at the sky with murderous intent, looking around, with a hint of concern in his eyes.

Just when Lu Dao was in danger, a familiar voice suddenly sounded from the city lord's mansion.

"You go, I'll still have me in the deserted city."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng stopped hesitating, nodded slightly, and then turned into a stream of light and soared into the sky.

In the end, everyone watched Lu Daosheng disappear at the end of the world.

They don't know what happened above the sky.

But it was definitely a war they could not imagine.

For a moment, Huangcheng returned to peace again, as if everything just now was just a illusion.

"Hiss~What are you doing when you pinch me?!"

"Let me see if I'm dreaming."

“…”

At this time, Gu Chen and others breathed a sigh of relief.

"Miss, what should I do now?"

An Xing looked at Lu Xue and asked.

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked straight at the city lord's mansion.

"Go and find my mother."

At the same time, outside the deserted city, there is a void.

"I didn't expect that there were such powerful people in this world. It was so terrifying."

Tan Songci looked towards the deserted city with an extremely solemn expression.

It was a coincidence that I could have seen such a good show.

He was even about to run away just now.

After all, if Huangcheng can't hold on and has never hit the other party, then there is no need to come.

As for Jordanyang, the mainland of the deserted city, all he could do was go back to the academy to build a tomb for him.

Fortunately, Huangcheng is very strong, countless times stronger than he thought.

The Lord of the Huangcheng City even chased the other party and fought.

Such a despicable combat power is truly unparalleled in the world.

After a long time of emotion, Tan Songci continued to rush towards the deserted city.

.........

"mother!"

After entering the city lord's mansion, Lu Xue and others saw Yan Lingyun standing in front of the hall, raising their heads and looking at the void.

Beside him, the two masters and disciples of Shi Liantian stood respectfully, silent.

But looking at the two of them trembling slightly, it was obvious that something happened in the city lord's mansion just now.

Hearing the sound, Yan Lingyun turned her head to look, and a soft smile suddenly appeared on her expressionless face.

"Xiaoxue, don't be afraid, mom is here."

Yan Lingyun gently stroked Lu Xue's face, and her hands were trembling slightly.

She couldn't believe what she should do if something happened to Lu Xue.

What will happen to Lu Daosheng then?

Fortunately, the accident did not happen.

"Mom, my dad,"

Lu Xue spoke with a hint of worry in her eyes and she was hesitant.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun chuckled and said, "Don't worry about your father. There is nothing in this world that he can't do."

As he said that, Yan Lingyun looked up at the void, and murderous intent surged out of her eyes.

"Even if your father doesn't go, I will go and ask for an explanation for you."

"How dare you touch my daughter?!"
